description.text: In the dark interior of a road tunnel,

sits almost hidden in shadow, its headlights casting two pale cones across the curved concrete ahead. The car eases forward and gathers pace, rolling out of the darkness as it sweeps left to right past the lane markings and hanging lamps, then clears the shadowed foreground and leaves the tunnel mouth behind.
eases forward out of the darkness, accelerating as it crosses the tunnel from left to right.
A low, close engine note builds; tires hiss over the tunnel road surface under a hollow, echoing ambience.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
